definitions.gloss: to slip out, to sneak out
definitions.explanation: To leave a place quietly or secretly without being noticed.

definitions.gloss: to escape, to get out of
definitions.explanation: To free oneself from a difficult situation, bad habit, or state.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{途中|とちゅう}でこっそり{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I slipped out quietly in the middle of the meeting.

examples.japanese: {不況|ふきょう}から{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}すのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's hard to escape from the recession.

examples.japanese: {悪循環|あくじゅんかん}から{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}せない。
examples.english: I can't break out of the vicious cycle.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Compound verb: {抜|ぬ}ける + {出|だ}す. Pattern: Xから{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す (slip out of X / escape from X).

ASPECT: ている indicates completed action or resulting state. {抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}している = 'has escaped' or 'is out.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{部屋|へや}から{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す (slip out of the room)
・スランプから{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す (break out of a slump)
・こっそり{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す (sneak out)

SIMILAR WORDS: {逃|に}げ{出|だ}す emphasizes fleeing from danger, while {抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す emphasizes quietly leaving or escaping a state.
